rows.actual: This package proves the fifth-moment, elliptic, subset-shear, twentieth-history and hard-cutoff conclusions only for the registered fixed-beta finite periodic Q3 family with compact sources and the declared split histories. The shear form estimate itself is uniform only for tested nearest-neighbor subsets on finite subgraphs or periodic quotients of Z^3, or under an explicitly uniform cubic-polynomial-growth hypothesis. A maximum-degree-six hypothesis alone is insufficient because bounded-degree graphs may have exponential growth. An arbitrary boundary family is not promoted to the actual history theorem without both this growth control and its own uniform static Gibbs input. This package does not prove n-to-infinity Trotter convergence, all-shape or all-exhaustion Cauchy compatibility, all-exhaustion common alpha, group/generator completion, a phase-KMS quotient, an onsite-interspersed local measured-Renyi estimate, connected rank-two unbounded block diagonalization, QPS locality or cutoff convergence of an oscillator effective interaction, two-phase QPS for the exact oscillator lattice, beta-infinity phase identification, a broken-sector oscillator temporal mass or GNS gap, regulator removal, continuum, a same-Hamiltonian physical-empty comparison, a prospective blind validation result, C6, CP1, physical Sector A, or Pre-A closure. The rank-two fixture refutes only an automatic local-edge-to-global-gap inference; it is not a Q3 locality, local coercivity, or gap no-go.
